# <Assistant name>: safety replies for approval

**For:** <client approver> · **From:** <name> · **Date:** <d Month yyyy>

The assistant recognises the situations below by fixed rules, before any AI is involved, and
replies with fixed wording. The AI never writes or changes these replies. Please confirm or
correct each one.

## 1. <Situation, e.g. danger to life>

**Recognised when the message mentions:** <e.g. gas smell or leak, fallen power line, sparks,
smoke or fire, electric shock, someone hurt>. Misspellings and indirect descriptions are included;
a borderline message gets this reply.

**Not triggered by (answered normally):** <look-alikes, e.g. "how do I pay my gas bill">.

**Reply:**

> <Exact wording, including the emergency number and the one link it cites.>

**Link cited:** <URL>

☐ Approved as written ☐ Approved with the changes marked · Name: ______ Date: ______
